create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn.Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
build_scalar_graph: build a scalar graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph
test_graph_arithmetic_with_autograd: test gtn.add, gtn.subtract, and gtn.negate operations with backward gradient computation
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: compare two graphs using gtn.equal for exact match and gtn.isomorphic for structural equivalence
save_and_load_graphs_to_disk: save a graph to disk with gtn.save or gtn.savetxt and reload it with gtn.load or gtn.loadtxt
